answer: The nectar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the signal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the glacier of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
